IC1: 1. TNM stage I-II (T1-4N0M0) colorectal cancer cases
IC3: 3. have completed data of tumor location, [OR] histological type, [OR] behavioral characteristics [OR] or TNM staging
IC4: 4. have tumor specimens [AND] and either a valid microsatellite instability (MSI) [OR] or immuno-histochemistry (IHC) data
IC5: 5. have valid V-raf murine sarcoma viral oncogene homolog B1 (BRAF), kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene (KRAS), CpG island methylator phenotype (CIMP) results
IC6: 6. have at least 4 years of follow-up
IC7: 7. have valid time to local recurrence/ [OR] metastasis in follow-up
IC8: 8. have clinical/treatment record data [AND] and valid preoperative status of intestinal obstruction or perforation (IOP), counts of lymph node removed in surgical resection.
